00027 // This class is a Cocoa/Objective-C wrapper for the Mac OS X Carbon API's
00028 // "icon family" data type.  Its main purpose is to enable Cocoa applications
00029 // to easily create custom file icons from NSImage instances, and thus take
00030 // advantage of Mac OS X's new larger RGBA "thumbnail" icon format to provide
00031 // richly detailed thumbnail previews of the files' contents.
00032 //
00033 // Using IconFamily, this becomes as simple as:
00034 //
00035 //      id iconFamily = [IconFamily iconFamilyWithThumbnailsOfImage:anImage];
00036 //      [iconFamily setAsCustomIconForFile:anExistingFile];
00037 //
00038 // You can also write an icon family to an .icns file using the -writeToFile:
00039 // method.
00040 
00041 @interface IconFamily : NSObject
00042 {
00043     IconFamilyHandle hIconFamily;
00044 }

00094 // Sets the image data for one of the icon family's elements from an
00095 // NSBitmapImageRep.  The "elementType" parameter must be one of the icon
00096 // family element types listed below, and the format of the "bitmapImageRep"
00097 // must match the corresponding requirements specified below.  Regardless of
00098 // the elementType, the bitmapImageRep must also be non-planar and have 8 bits
00099 // per sample.
00100 //
00101 //  elementType                       dimensions   format
00102 //  -------------------               ----------   ---------------------------------------
00103 //  kIconServices512PixelDataARGB     512 x 512   32-bit RGBA, 32-bit RGB, or 24-bit RGB
00104 //  kIconServices256PixelDataARGB     256 x 256   32-bit RGBA, 32-bit RGB, or 24-bit RGB
00105 //  kThumbnail32BitData               128 x 128   32-bit RGBA, 32-bit RGB, or 24-bit RGB
00106 //  kThumbnail8BitMask                128 x 128   32-bit RGBA or 8-bit intensity
00107 //  kLarge32BitData                   32 x  32   32-bit RGBA, 32-bit RGB, or 24-bit RGB
00108 //  kLarge8BitMask                    32 x  32   32-bit RGBA or 8-bit intensity
00109 //  kLarge1BitMask                    32 x  32   32-bit RGBA, 8-bit intensity, or 1-bit
00110 //  kSmall32BitData                   16 x  16   32-bit RGBA, 32-bit RGB, or 24-bit RGB
00111 //  kSmall8BitMask                    16 x  16   32-bit RGBA or 8-bit intensity
00112 //  kSmall1BitMask                    16 x  16   32-bit RGBA, 8-bit intensity, or 1-bit
00113 //
00114 // When an RGBA image is supplied to set a "Mask" element, the mask data is
00115 // taken from the image's alpha channel.
00116 //
00117 // NOTE: Setting an IconFamily's kLarge1BitMask seems to damage the IconFamily
00118 //       for some as yet unknown reason.  (If you then assign the icon family
00119 //       as a file's custom icon using -setAsCustomIconForFile:, the custom
00120 //       icon doesn't appear for the file in the Finder.)  However, both
00121 //       custom icon display and mouse-click hit-testing in the Finder seem to
00122 //       work fine when we only set the other four elements (thus keeping the
00123 //       existing kLarge1BitMask from the valid icon family from which we
00124 //       initialized the IconFamily via -initWithContentsOfFile:, since
00125 //       IconFamily's -init method is currently broken...), so it seems safe
00126 //       to just leave the kLarge1BitMask alone.
00127 
00128 - (BOOL) setIconFamilyElement:(OSType)elementType
00129            fromBitmapImageRep:(NSBitmapImageRep*)bitmapImageRep;
00130 
00131 // Gets the image data for one of the icon family's elements as a new, 32-bit
00132 // RGBA NSBitmapImageRep.  The specified elementType should be one of
00133 // kIconServices512PixelDataARGB, kIconServices256PixelDataARGB,
00134 // kThumbnail32BitData, kLarge32BitData, or kSmall32BitData.
00135 //
00136 // The returned NSBitmapImageRep will have the corresponding 8-bit mask data
00137 // in its alpha channel, or a fully opaque alpha channel if the icon family
00138 // has no 8-bit mask data for the specified alpha channel.
00139 //
00140 // Returns nil if the requested element cannot be retrieved (e.g. if the
00141 // icon family has no such 32BitData element).
00142 
00143 - (NSBitmapImageRep*) bitmapImageRepWithAlphaForIconFamilyElement:(OSType)elementType;

00147 
00148 - (NSImage*) imageWithAllReps;
